tools.name: submit_quote_request
tools.description: Send the person's answers and contact details to a licensed agent, who shops the request with our carriers and contacts them (usually same business day). findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_guides, get_quote_questions · Private data: request_callback, submit_quote_request · Public sink: request_callback, submit_quote_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_guides, get_quote_questions · Private data: request_callback, submit_quote_request · Public sink: request_callback, submit_quote_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
